entities.name: Abd al-Latif al-Baghdadi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbd al-Laṭīf al-Baghdādī, short for Muwaffaq al-Dīn Muḥammad ʿAbd al-Laṭīf ibn Yūsuf al-Baghdādī, was a physician, philosopher, historian, Arabic grammarian and traveller, and one of the most voluminous writers of his time.
